[Bounty: $50] Make get_round report no recipient for a round that has not started
opportunities.description:
## Context

`RoundInfo.recipient` is documented as "`None` for a round that does not exist yet" (`contracts/group/src/lib.rs:169`), but `get_round` (`:723`) reads `DataKey::MemberAt(round)` for any round `<= member_capacity`, so a round far in the future returns the scheduled recipient while its phase is `WaitingForContributions`. The distinction the doc promises does not hold.

## Proposed Change

Return `recipient: None` when `round > current_round` (and no payout has executed), or correct the documentation and consumers to the actual semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `get_round(r)` for a not-yet-started `r` returns `recipient: None`
- A completed/current round still returns its recipient
- A test covers a future round

**Suggested Label:** correctness
**ETA:** 24 hours

opportunities.description:
### 赏金平台 / Platform
GitHub

### 原始链接 / Source URL
https://github.com/Grainlify/grainlify-bounty-agent/issues/1

### 漏洞描述 / Description
Record the real network fee in the ledger, not only the capped estimate

**The problem**

When the agent pays for inference over x402, the Solana network fee is most of what the call costs — in our measurements a paid call cost $0.002031, of which $0.002004 was the network fee. So the fee is the number most worth getting right.

The signer already knows exactly what the fee was: `res.feeLamports`, taken from the confirmed transaction. It converts that to micro-USD using `solUsdCeilingPrice`, a deliberately high fixed SOL price ($400) chosen so the budget can never under-count spend.

That conversion is the only thing kept. `inference_calls` stores `fee_micro` and no lamports, so the ledger reports a conservative estimate and the exact figure is thrown away.

**Where in the code**

- `services/signer/src/signer.ts` — `PayResult` carries `fee_lamports`; look for `lamportsToMicroCeil(res.feeLamports, ...)`.
- `packages/x402/src/client.ts` — the settle call that records the payment drops `fee_lamports`.
- `db/migrations/` — add a new forward-only migrat

## Summary
In `backend/routers/imports.py` and `backend/database/import_jobs.py`, the data import pipeline contained critical security and error disclosure vulnerabilities:

1. **Path Traversal on File Upload (`import_limitless_data`)**:
   - The user-provided `file.filename` was directly joined with `TEMP_DIR`:

     ```python
     zip_path = os.path.join(TEMP_DIR, f"{job.id}_{file.filename}")
     ```
   - Filenames with path traversal sequences (`../../../../tmp/malicious.zip`) escaped the temp directory, allowing arbitrary file writes across the host filesystem.

2. **Raw Internal Exception & Path Disclosure**:

opportunities.title: P0 launch blocker: confirm commercial rights for Bing RSS retrieval and persisted search-result evidence
opportunities.description:
## 27 September 2026 — material third-party data-rights finding

Current free-only production path `lib/free-web-retrieval.ts` fetches ordinary Bing search results using **public `www.bing.com/search?format=rss`**, parses result titles, links and snippets, transmits them as grounding context to Cloudflare Workers AI, and persists returned reference links in Foremention Recommendation Records/Source Map. This is **not** an authenticated or contracted Bing Search/grounding API integration. A read-only live sample of this public RSS response displayed an explicit Microsoft restriction on use beyond personal, non-commercial RSS presentation absent express permission. This creates a material **commercial use and output retention/licensing question**, not proof of an adjudicated breach.

opportunities.title: Split sw-loop.sh into focused lib modules under scripts/lib/
opportunities.description:
## Strategic Improvement

sw-loop.sh is the largest script in the repo at 2713 lines, mixing iteration control, session-continuity, progress persistence, error-summary generation, and restart logic in one file. Decompose it into scripts/lib/loop-{iteration,session,progress,restart}.sh modules following the same monolith-decomposition pattern already underway per docs/AGI-PLATFORM-PLAN.md Phase 4 (3.1/3.3), improving testability and reducing the risk of regressions when touching loop behavior.

### Acceptance Criteria
- - sw-loop.sh reduced to a thin orchestrator that sources new lib modules
- - Each extracted module has its own unit test file (sw-lib-loop-*-test.sh) with parity coverage of existing sw-loop-test.sh assertions
- - No change in CLI behavior or flags; full existing sw-loop-test.sh suite passes unmodified
- - CLAUDE.md core-scripts/test-suites AUTO sections updated to reflect new files
